user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate between the iframe example links on the Frames page so that I can explore the nested frames and iframe functionalities. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click on the link with text 'Nested Frames', I should be redirected to the URL '/nested_frames'. 
2. When I click on the link with text 'iFrame', I should be redirected to the URL '/iframe'. 
3. The page should contain a div with id 'content' that includes the text 'Frames Nested Frames iFrame'.
